scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node --no-deprecation ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm --silent run dev --prefix server" "npm --silent run dev --prefix client"
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
